name: Databricks
sku: Databricks platform. Documentation reviewed on the AWS docs site. Other products, such as Genie and agent tooling, are not scored, so derived coverage may understate the platform.

presentation.tagline: Lakehouse platform: Spark compute, warehouse SQL, orchestration and governance under one contract.

cost.note: A few notebook sessions and light scheduled jobs. DBU rates run $0.07-0.70/DBU by compute type on top of the underlying cloud compute bill, which this range includes.
Third-party estimate: most teams spend $500-5,000+/month, including the underlying cloud infrastructure cost, which typically adds 30-60% on top of the DBU charge alone.
Third-party estimate for a mid-size team, including cloud infrastructure, was $2,000-10,000/month; widened upward for genuinely high-volume, many-pipeline use.
